# Real HEVC files decoded through avkit's container.Reader (MP4 and Matroska)
# and compared picture by picture with ffmpeg 9.0.2 -f framemd5 (native pixel
# format, one thread). The files are not in this repository and are not named:
# only what describes them and the hash of the result. Each is the first 200
# video packets of the file in decoding order, cut with
# `jvt --codec hevc file --frames 200` (stream copy). Taken 2026-11-08 with
# gen2brain/h265 v0.2.4; ffmpeg matched on every picture. The files come from a
# census of 195 HEVC files in one library: 173 Main, 21 Main 10 (all 4:2:0).
#
# sample entry, size, profile, pixel format, frames, md5-of-the-per-picture-md5s (joined by newline)

hev1 540x960    Main10   yuv420p10le 200 b64bf841278b41959384e8b523dd99ea
hvc1 886x1578   Main     yuvj420p    200 be67e195e563cfaded4f8932870695b6
hev1 1920x1080  Main     yuv420p     200 d5b1bc9609d572d33313746760ac280d
hev1 1920x1080  Main     yuv420p     200 fc590ac69656fdb19650bd2b2387f3c8
hev1 1920x1080  Main     yuv420p     200 1eeccdd95591d979e2017eeb2ed6f2b0
